payload.reason: The authors aimed to improve extractive summarization by incorporating hierarchical structure information into their model, which was tested on CNN/DailyMail among other datasets.

claims.text: The authors experimented with their model on CNN/DailyMail to evaluate the effectiveness of injecting hierarchical structure information into extractive summarization.
The performance improvements on CNN/DailyMail were small, possibly due to the lack of section titles in the dataset, which limited the hierarchical information available.
